title: Ixidor Creates Akroma
summary: Ixidor turns grief over Nivea's death into the reality-sculpted angel Akroma and a vendetta against Phage.
narrative: After Nivea died in a pit encounter with Phage, Ixidor's powers as an illusionist developed into the ability to make imagined beings real.
He created Akroma as an instrument of vengeance. The conflict between Akroma and Phage spread beyond personal grief into a devastating confrontation between their followers.
